name: portracker
description: Live, self-hosted port monitoring and discovery for your homelab

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with your settings, peers and login.

paths.name: Docker.Sock
paths.description: Read-only access to Docker, used to find your containers and their ports.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Dashboard web UI, published on host as 6158

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: ENABLE_AUTH
variables.description: Turns on portracker's login screen and setup wizard. Set to false to leave the dashboard open to anyone on your network.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Pre-filled with a random value. It keeps you signed in when the app restarts. You can replace it with your own random text.
